units.source_text: 阴阳杂记云，器物经百年，得化为精灵，诓骗人心，人们把它称做付丧神。

en.t: The Miscellaneous Records of Yin and Yang says that when objects have existed for a hundred years, they can transform into spirits and deceive human hearts; people call them tsukumogami.

units.source_text: 由是，世俗在每年立春前夕，家家清除旧家具，扔弃在路旁，叫做大扫除。

en.t: For this reason, it became the custom each year on the eve of the beginning of spring for every household to clear out old furniture and throw it away by the roadside, calling this a great cleaning.

units.source_text: 这样使得不足百年的付丧神速了灾难。

en.t: In this way, tsukumogami that had not yet reached a hundred years were made to meet disaster.
